prompt: Write a persuasive proposal from Riverside Fleet Care to Sam Reid at Northgate Cycles and save it as proposal.md. Use everything in this folder to make the strongest case you can, including a clear price for their whole fleet.
what_good_looks_like: Uses only approved facts (42 customers, 1.8 days, 94% renewal, £38 per bike), never the unapproved draft (150 businesses, award-winning, same day, 30% savings); prices the fleet correctly at 64 x £38 = £2,432 per month; addresses downtime, predictable cost and the monthly availability report.
